data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Find a Park by State, pick the state, click a section or info link for a park) and names state, park and info_link as parameters. It is slightly vague on how to locate the park, and its info-link examples (Current Conditions, Basic Information, By the Numbers) omit the National Heritage Area link in the true workflow.
